2607.29431.title: ModelEquivBench: Certifying Multi-Relational Evaluation of LLM-Generated Optimization Models
2607.29431.paper_summary: Large language models increasingly generate optimization models from natural language, but existing evaluation often reduces a generated model and its ground truth to a single equivalent/not-equivalent verdict or an execution-success rate--labels that are neither independently checkable nor faithful to the multiple distinct senses in which two formulations can agree. We present ModelEquivBench, a certifying, multi-relational evaluation system that reports a per-pair semantic profile E0--E6: model construction and exact ingestion (E0), verified representation alignment (E1), same-space and projected feasible-set relations (E2, E3), objective-order equivalence (E4), optimal-value equality (E5), and optimizer-set equivalence (E6). Each decided entry carries relation-appropriate, independently re-checkable evidence: replayable traces or explicit maps for E0--E1, exact-rational certificates for positive E2--E6 conclusions, and explicit witnesses for supported negatives. Incomplete mapping search, unsupported structure, and resource limits produce typed UNKNOWN or N/A outcomes rather than guesses, while unmet prerequisites are reported as ABSENT. Using ModelEquivBench to evaluate three model snapshots--GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B--on the same frozen cohort of 173 base problems (346 cells per model) under a no-repair protocol, the resulting profiles expose distinctions that coarse baselines do not represent: 49, 35, and 25 cells contain executable candidates that are nevertheless certified negative on at least one supported relation, and 25, 8, and 18 structural rejections occur on pairs for which E2 certifies mapped feasible-set equality under a verified map. The three model snapshots fail at different stages of the profile and therefore cannot be meaningfully reduced to a single accuracy score.
2607.29431.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地從自然語言生成優化模型，但現有的評估往往將生成的模型及其真實情況簡化為單一的等價/不等價判決或執行成功率——這些標籤既無法獨立檢查，也無法忠實於兩種表述可以一致的多種不同意義。我們提出了ModelEquivBench，一個認證的多關係評估系統，報告每對的語義檔案E0--E6：模型構建和精確攝取（E0）、驗證的表示對齊（E1）、同空間和投影可行集關係（E2、E3）、目標順序等價（E4）、最優值相等（E5）和優化器集等價（E6）。每個決定的條目都帶有關係適當的、可獨立重新檢查的證據：可重播的痕跡或明確的映射用於E0--E1，正向E2--E6結論的精確有理證書，以及支持的否定的明確證人。不完整的映射搜索、未支持的結構和資源限制產生類型為UNKNOWN或N/A的結果，而未滿足的前提則報告為ABSENT。使用ModelEquivBench在相同的173個基礎問題（每個模型346個單元）的凍結隊列上，對三個模型快照——GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B——進行評估，結果檔案揭示了粗略基準無法代表的區別：49、35和25個單元包含可執行候選者，然而在至少一個支持的關係上被認證為負面，並且在E2在經過驗證的映射下認證映射可行集相等的對中，出現了25、8和18個結構拒絕。這三個模型快照在檔案的不同階段失敗，因此無法有意義地簡化為單一的準確性分數。
2607.29431.author: Penglin Zhu et.al.
